svg.text: Option E — PRIMARY DESIGN BASIS · owner sketch corrected
South alley stair + covered lower patio + stacked east patios · garage/bath/office/sunroom below · west bedroom + roof-aware open kitchen/living above
north ↑ · property line 5' — keep this wall (nearly) window-free
south stair zone · 5' clear to selected 18' x 6' replacement shed
east · yard & main house · morning sun
top landing connects directly to upper patio
LOW EAVE ZONE — storage / low fixtures
LEVEL 2 — apartment · 480 sf gross / 437 sf net
north ↑ · property line 5' — keep this wall (nearly) window-free
south stair zone · 5' clear to selected 18' x 6' replacement shed
east · yard & main house · morning sun
• DESIGN BASIS: preserves the owner's two-level sketch, west bedroom/bath core, central TV wall, open living room, and stacked east patios.
• KITCHEN FIX: fridge + pantry move to the full-height east gable; sink/range island sits beneath the E-W ridge, clear of low north/south eaves.
• LEVEL 1: garage left; bath north-center; office northeast; sunroom below; covered south patio connects around the corner to the east patio.
• LEVEL 2 ENTRY: south stair and top landing lead to an east patio directly above level 1; apartment entry is a sliding glass door.
• GARAGE CHECK: exact sketch proportions leave only about 13'-6" clear depth; enlarge/rebalance footprint or reduce sunroom width for a typical 16' car.
• AREA/ZONING CHECK: confirm whether enclosed office/sunroom count as ADU living area; upper level alone is 480 sf gross against the working 500 sf cap.
• ROOF/SITE CHECK: verify section/headroom and the selected 5' shed-to-stair zone for safe fire, drainage, and maintenance clearance.
